name: Carel Fredrik Kolbe — death in February 1876, Cape Town, South Africa
researcher_question: When and where did Carel Fredrik Kolbe, baptised 6 December 1801 in Cape Town, son of Jacobus Kolbe and Johanna Magdalena Paulsen, and married to Dolphina Carolina Hartog in Cape Town in 1857, die?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-3.csv row 25, hint-samples.csv row 816, flags adds_death/adds_burial, confidence 3). Resolved 2026-10-16 (issue #3345): true match. The hint is the Cape Town Dutch Reformed congregation's 1875-1877 list of deceased confirmed members (read on the page image ark:/61903/3:1:3Q9M-CSK6-Y315-G), which no child could appear in, so neither a grandson nor the 1866-born Carel Fredrik Kolbee can be the entry; image_basis is true. See README, Notes for reviewers.
